summarization: The smartphone UI screen displays a list of "Hot Events," which appear to be live streams or broadcasts related to various police departments and emergency services. Each entry includes the name of the event or department, along with the number of listeners currently tuned in. The list includes entries from different locations, primarily in the United States, with a few from Canada and Australia. The screen also features a banner ad at the bottom promoting reverse mortgage facts. The top status bar shows standard icons for notifications, battery, and time.
